# Frozen commit subjects that already carried the review identity.
#
# Each line is one full commit id whose subject carries the identity and cannot
# be rewritten, because rewriting pushed history is forbidden outright. The
# list is a ratchet: it only ever shrinks, and every entry must be a commit
# that exists on this line of history, is an ancestor of HEAD, and whose
# subject still carries the identity.
#
# This lineage forked before the two commits the main line quarantines, so it
# carries no subjects to freeze: any entry copied across lines would fail the
# guard as "not an ancestor of HEAD". If a subject ever needs freezing here,
# the entry is added with the commit that introduced it.
